definitionZh: 注意：ARIA 1.1 引入了对分隔符角色的更改，因此它在可聚焦时表现为一个小部件。虽然此模式已经过修改以匹配 ARIA 1.1 规范，但工作组将在完成符合 ARIA 1.1 规范的功能示例之前完成审核。第 129 期跟踪了该模式的进展。
sourceDefinition: NOTE: ARIA 1.1 introduced changes to the separator role so it behaves as a widget when focusable. While this pattern has been revised to match the ARIA 1.1 specification, the task force will not complete its review until a functional example that matches the ARIA 1.1 specification is complete. Progress on this pattern is tracked by issue 129.
